title: Scheduled jobs stuck in Queued state after Automation Server upgrade
body: After upgrading Automation Server, scheduled jobs remain queued. Cause: worker service runs under a service account missing 'Log on as a service' right. Resolution: grant the right, restart the worker service, verify worker registers in the admin console.

title: ODBC connector fails with 'Data source name not found and no default driver specified'
body: Error IM002 occurs when the DSN is created in 32-bit ODBC administrator but the client runs 64-bit, or the driver is not installed. Resolution: recreate DSN in 64-bit ODBC administrator, confirm driver bitness matches client.

title: SSO login fails with SAML response signature invalid
body: Authentication fails after identity provider certificate rotation. The service provider still trusts the old signing certificate. Resolution: upload the new IdP signing certificate / refresh federation metadata, then restart the web service.

title: Desktop Authoring Client slow to open large workflows
body: Performance degrades when workflows contain many cached inputs and the temp directory is on a network drive. Resolution: move the temp directory to a local SSD, clear cache, increase memory allocation setting.

title: Cloud data warehouse connector timeout during large extracts
body: Queries over the default 300 second timeout fail with a read timeout. Resolution: increase connector query timeout, enable bulk/streaming mode, and filter at source to reduce extract size.

title: Installer fails with error 1603 during Automation Server install
body: MSI error 1603 is a generic fatal error. Common causes: pending Windows reboot, insufficient permissions, antivirus locking files. Resolution: reboot, run installer as administrator, temporarily exclude install directory from antivirus, review verbose MSI log.

title: Proxy authentication required (HTTP 407) when client connects to server
body: Corporate proxy intercepts traffic and requires authentication. Resolution: configure proxy credentials in client settings or add the server host to the proxy bypass list.

title: API token expired causing 401 Unauthorized on automated jobs
body: Automated jobs using personal access tokens fail with 401 once the token expires. Resolution: rotate the token, use a service principal with longer-lived credentials, update the job connection.

title: DEFECT: Cloud warehouse connector drops rows when column names contain unicode
body: Rows silently dropped when source column names include non-ASCII unicode characters. Workaround: alias columns to ASCII names in the source query. Fix targeted for a future release.

title: DEFECT: Worker service memory leak on long-running schedules
body: Worker memory grows unbounded on schedules running more than 12 hours, eventually crashing the service. Fixed in the next maintenance release.

title: Runbook: collecting a diagnostic bundle from Automation Server
body: Collect service logs, engine logs, configuration export and Windows event logs. Use the diagnostic bundle utility. Do not collect database dumps without customer consent.

title: Internal: how to read a Fiddler / HAR trace for client-server issues
body: Filter by host, look for 401/403/407 status codes, TLS handshake failures, and requests exceeding timeout. Proxy 407 indicates proxy auth, 401 indicates identity issue.

title: Resolved: Oracle connector ORA-12154 TNS could not resolve connect identifier
body: tnsnames.ora not found by the client because TNS_ADMIN environment variable not set for the service account. Set TNS_ADMIN system-wide and restart.

title: Resolved: Server web portal blank after TLS certificate renewal
body: New certificate bound without the intermediate chain; browsers rejected handshake. Rebind certificate with full chain and restart web service.
